summary.ko: 검증된 제품 사실을 바탕으로 비교 가능한 광고 메시지 변형을 만듭니다.
summary.en: Create meaningfully distinct ad variants tied to explicit messaging hypotheses.

exclusions: Full experiment design and statistical planning

required_inputs.description: Audience, offer, approved benefits, evidence, and restrictions
Channel, placement, character limits, and destination promise

workflow.instruction: Identify testable message angles based on real benefits and audience needs.
Create variants that change one strategic angle at a time while keeping essential offer facts consistent.
Write the required headline, body, description, and CTA fields within supplied limits.
Check claim support, destination consistency, sensitive targeting concerns, and what each variant is meant to test.

deliverables.name: Ad variant matrix
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each variant has hypothesis, angle, copy fields, claim basis, and format checks

limitations: Do not guarantee ad approval, conversion rates, or revenue.
Current channel rules must be verified when a compliance judgment is needed.
permission_boundaries: Do not launch ads, set budgets, upload audiences, or target people using sensitive traits.
Do not fabricate urgency, endorsements, or before-and-after claims.
